description: yass: three one-line shell hooks, no scripts. After a compaction, and at most every check_every_min minutes of tool activity (the pulse), they start the seat-check agent in the background (claude -p). While a switch waits for subagents to wind down, PostToolUse hands the main thread a one-time note, and SubagentStop starts the switch once little subagent context is alive or the deadline passed. Each exits in milliseconds when there is nothing to do; all do nothing until onboarding wrote ~/.yass/policy.md, in sessions that use a token from the environment, or inside a check.

hooks.command: D="$HOME/.yass"; [ -z "$YASS_CHILD" ] && [ -z "$CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN" ] && [ -f "$D/policy.md" ] && [ "$(jq -r .auto "$D/config.json" 2>/dev/null)" != false ] || exit 0; L() { (cd "$D" && env -u CLAUDECODE -u CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION -u CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID YASS_CHILD=1 nohup "${CLAUDE_CODE_EXECPATH:-$HOME/.local/bin/claude}" -p "$1" --agent yass:seat-check --model "$(jq -r '.model // "sonnet"' "$D/config.json")" --allowedTools=Bash,Read,Write,Edit --no-session-persistence >> "$D/check.log" 2>&1 &); }; [ -z "$(find "$D/last-check" -mmin -10 2>/dev/null)" ] || exit 0; touch "$D/last-check"; L 'Seat check. Trigger: compact.'; exit 0

D="$HOME/.yass"; [ -z "$YASS_CHILD" ] && [ -z "$CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN" ] && [ -f "$D/policy.md" ] && [ "$(jq -r .auto "$D/config.json" 2>/dev/null)" != false ] || exit 0; L() { (cd "$D" && env -u CLAUDECODE -u CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION -u CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID YASS_CHILD=1 nohup "${CLAUDE_CODE_EXECPATH:-$HOME/.local/bin/claude}" -p "$1" --agent yass:seat-check --model "$(jq -r '.model // "sonnet"' "$D/config.json")" --allowedTools=Bash,Read,Write,Edit --no-session-persistence >> "$D/check.log" 2>&1 &); }; I=$(cat); if [ -z "$(find "$D/last-check" -mmin -"$(jq -r '.check_every_min // 30' "$D/config.json")" 2>/dev/null)" ]; then touch "$D/last-check"; L 'Seat check. Trigger: pulse.'; fi; [ -n "$(find "$D/notice.json" -mmin -30 2>/dev/null)" ] && [ -z "$(printf %s "$I" | jq -r '.agent_id // empty')" ] || exit 0; K="$D/run/noted-$(printf %s "$I" | jq -r .session_id)-$(jq -r .id "$D/notice.json")"; [ -f "$K" ] && exit 0; mkdir -p "$D/run"; touch "$K"; jq -c '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PostToolUse", additionalContext: .text}}' "$D/notice.json"; exit 0

D="$HOME/.yass"; [ -z "$YASS_CHILD" ] && [ -z "$CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN" ] && [ -f "$D/policy.md" ] && [ "$(jq -r .auto "$D/config.json" 2>/dev/null)" != false ] || exit 0; L() { (cd "$D" && env -u CLAUDECODE -u CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION -u CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID YASS_CHILD=1 nohup "${CLAUDE_CODE_EXECPATH:-$HOME/.local/bin/claude}" -p "$1" --agent yass:seat-check --model "$(jq -r '.model // "sonnet"' "$D/config.json")" --allowedTools=Bash,Read,Write,Edit --no-session-persistence >> "$D/check.log" 2>&1 &); }; [ -f "$D/pending.json" ] || exit 0; A=$(jq -r '.agent_id // empty'); A=${A:-none}; [ "$(date +%s)" -ge "$(jq -r '.after // 0' "$D/pending.json")" ] || exit 0; LIVE=$(find "$HOME/.claude/projects" -path '*/subagents/*' -name '*.jsonl' -mmin -2 ! -name "*$A*" 2>/dev/null | while read -r f; do tail -n 40 "$f" | jq -s '[.[] | .message.usage? // empty | (.input_tokens // 0) + (.cache_read_input_tokens // 0) + (.cache_creation_input_tokens // 0)] | last // 0'; done | awk '{s+=$1} END {print s+0}'); [ "$LIVE" -le "$(jq -r '.max_live_context // 150000' "$D/pending.json")" ] || [ "$(date +%s)" -ge "$(jq -r '.deadline // 0' "$D/pending.json")" ] || exit 0; mkdir -p "$D/run"; mv "$D/pending.json" "$D/run/pending.taken" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; L "Switch to $(jq -r .target "$D/run/pending.taken"). Reason: $(jq -r .reason "$D/run/pending.taken"). Planned switch; live subagent context now $LIVE tokens."; exit 0
